header.running_head: 3. The Rights and Duties of Muslims

blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه البخاري باب الوصاءة بالجار رقم:٦٠١٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Aishah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Hazrat Jibra'il (AS) kept advising me about the duty owed to the neighbour, (so much so that through that advice) I began to think that the neighbour would be given a right to a share in inheritance.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ عَامِرٍ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُوْلُ اللهِ ﷺ: اَوَّلُ خَصْمَيْنِ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ جَارَانِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه احمد باسناد حسن مجمع الزوائد:٦٣٢/١٠
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Uqbah ibn Amir (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “The first to bring a case on the Day of Qiyamah will be two neighbours who quarrelled with each other; in matters concerning the rights (of servants), (the first place will go to the case) concerning two neighbours.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ سَعْدٍ ﵁ اَنَّ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ قَالَ: لَا يُرِيْدُ اَحَدٌ اَهْلَ الْمَدِيْنَةِ بِسُوْءٍ اِلَّا اَذَابَهُ اللهُ فِي النَّارِ ذَوْبَ الرَّصَاصِ اَوْ ذَوْبَ الْمِلْحِ فِي الْمَاءِ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Sa'd (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “Whoever intends any harm to the people of Madinah, Allah Ta'ala will melt (and dissolve) him in the fire (of Jahannam) just as lead is melted in fire or as salt dissolves in water.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵄ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُوْلَ اللهِ ﷺ
